lints.name: rls_enabled_no_policy
lints.title: RLS Enabled No Policy
lints.description: Detects cases where row level security (RLS) has been enabled on a table but no RLS policies have been created.

findings.detail: Table \`gk_private.access_memberships\` has RLS enabled, but no policies exist

lints.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.

findings.detail: Function `public.gk_manage_membership(p_user uuid, p_role text, p_active boolean, p_private_read boolean, p_private_write boolean, p_approval_reference text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/gk_manage_membership`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

metadata.name: gk_manage_membership
